frontmatter.name: prompt-deep-optimizer
frontmatter.description: Optimize a production system prompt, agent instruction block, tool-call template, or workflow scaffold that lives in code and runs repeatedly. Runs a 16-pass audit, applies every Medium+ fix, loops to convergence, and outputs the drop-in rewrite plus a named algorithm pick (APE, OPRO, MIPROv2, GEPA, ProTeGi, TextGrad, EvoPrompt) or "structural-only" without training data. TRIGGER: "optimize this system prompt"; "run pdo"; "harden the tool-call template we ship"; inconsistent prompt output; audit a prompt for injection holes; which prompt optimization algorithm; champion-challenger held-out loop on a prompt. SKIP: one-off or exploratory prompts under ~600 tokens → prompt-helper-optimizer (/ph, /phe); machine-generated or DSPy-compiled prompts; skill files → skill-optimizer; prose documents → ddo, writing-expert (references/document-critique.md); plan and run a whole task → p; eval suites, cost of running a prompt → misc-catch-all (deep-eval-optimizer /deo, prompt-cost-estimator).
